parts.text: Sugar and flour for making cakes are measured in cups. The mass, in grams, of one cup of sugar has the distribution $\text{N}(250, 10)$. The mass, in grams, of one cup of flour has the independent distribution $\text{N}(160, 9)$. Each cake contains 2 cups of sugar and 5 cups of flour. Find the probability that the total mass of sugar and flour in one cake exceeds 1310 grams.
